# Tier exceptions: imports that break the tier rules in tests/fixtures/tier_map.txt
# today. This file only shrinks. Delete a line when its import goes away; the
# tier test fails on a line that names no current violation. CI fails a pull
# request that adds a line unless it carries the `layering-exception` label.
#
# Each line is `importer -> target`. Under [libraries] the target is a
# library: anthropic belongs to the provider group, fastmcp and mcp to the
# surfaces tier, urllib.request to the seams tier.
#
# Until athenaeum#3225: an edge whose target is store, storage (any
# submodule), atomic_io, runlock or sync_lease is reported but never fails,
# whether it is listed here or not.
